chapters.title: Find a place
chapters.body: Visitors search a village or a name. Small hosts with no website appear with counts-only feedback and the days they can take guests, which they publish a week ahead.

chapters.title: Book a visit
chapters.body: Saturday, two guests, English. “Who told you about this place?” links the booking to a past guest. The request goes to the tour company; no payment here.

chapters.title: Confirmed: an SMS for a basic phone
chapters.body: The tour company sees the request, confirms it, and sends the host a plain SMS from its own phone. No internet needed on the host’s side.

chapters.title: Next week, on the helper’s phone
chapters.body: The booking is in next week’s list with the language pack already on the phone. Rare languages are downloaded before a visit and deleted afterwards.

chapters.title: Vivian writes on Noor’s phone
chapters.body: The host hands over the phone. The screen is in the guest’s language: what they liked, what could be better, what they would buy, and a consent tick.

chapters.title: A photo of the guestbook
chapters.body: Lukas wrote in German in box A. A text reader on the phone reads the photo; words it is unsure of are shown in yellow for a helper to fix.

chapters.title: A voice note
chapters.body: Sophie left a voice message in French. Whisper, on the phone, writes it down and translates it to English.

chapters.title: The week, in Swahili
chapters.body: The helper taps Analyse. Translation, topics and mood run on the phone. The summary is human-written Swahili with the AI’s counts filled in; “Sikiliza” reads it aloud with recorded clips.

chapters.title: Check what the AI was unsure about
chapters.body: Each topic keeps the guests’ own words. Sentences the model is unsure about are marked “Check”, with a one-tap correction.

chapters.title: A thank-you for Vivian
chapters.body: A human-written note in the guest’s language, with its meaning underneath. Sent only with consent, and only when the host taps send.

chapters.title: A report for the tour company
chapters.body: Counts only: how many guests, what they liked, what to improve, what they wanted to buy. No names, no quotes. Shared only if the host agrees.

chapters.title: Our take on localising AI
chapters.body: Models stay language-agnostic (English pivot); every word a person reads is human-written in their language. Swahili and English are built in; guest packs come and go; Chagga is not pretended.
